messages:
maria: Quick experiment FYI — I pushed a stride-based batch admission probe to staging. Idea: instead of a single global token budget we scale per-worker 'stride' budgets to favor forming mid-sized batches when KV-hit rate < 40% so we avoid tiny-batch overheads.

jason: neat. can you paste the config?

maria: config snippet: ```json
{
  "admit_strategy": "stride-scaled",
  "base_token_budget": 64,
  "stride_multiplier": 1.5,
  "kv_hit_threshold": 0.40,
  "soft_reject_pct": 0.12,
  "lease_secs": 0.7
}
```

sara: where does kernel selection come in here? are we biasing to the fused-gemm path for mid-sized batches? :thinking:

maria: yes — admission sets a target batch size hint. runtime prefers fused-gemm for batch_size >= 8 and falls back to tiled-attn for <8. The probe forces more batches above that threshold when KV-hit low.

kevin: ran quick perf numbers on staging (model xlarge-8):
- baseline (uniform budget): p95 latency 240ms, tokens/s 420
- stride-scaled: p95 latency 225ms, tokens/s 475
- cost/token ~ -6% observed in a 30m window
KV-hit during probe ~ 28%.

ben: interesting. did you see any increase in 429s or soft-rejects?

maria: soft 429s rose slightly from 0.8% -> 1.5% inbound, but we saw fewer microbatches and fewer kernel context switches. No hard 429s.

jason: can we tweak soft_reject_pct down if we want to prioritize fewer 429s? what's tradeoff?

maria: lowering soft_reject_pct to 0.08 reduces soft 429s to ~1.0% but p95 latency creeps to 232ms. tradeoff is cost vs tail latency.

kevin: profiler trace shows reduced memcpy churn on fused-gemm runs. KV cache misses still dominate CPU scheduling though — we might combine with a small prefetch window for cold keys.

maria: agreed. next step: run a +prefetch window of 64 tokens for workers with stride multiplier >1.5 and measure KV evictions.

deploy-bot: deploy staging cluster: stride-scaled admission probe v1 -> success :rocket:

ben: note: keep an eye on warmup effects — first 10 minutes had weird low throughput while kernels JITted. filter those windows out of the comparison.

maria: action items: 1) kevin to run prefetch window + profiler (kv evict heatmap) 2) jason to run longer 6h A/B with soft_reject_pct 0.12 vs 0.08 3) sara to add kernel-switch counters to the admission telemetry. I'll roll probe to more nodes after results.

sara: ping me on the telemetry PR and I can add dashboards for stride distribution and kernel-path ratio.

maria: thanks all — logging results to the performance board. o/
